headline: KOSPI Regains 7,000, But Will My Stocks Rise Too, or Will Only Semiconductors Gain Again?
summary: The KOSPI has recovered the 7,000 level. Analysts say gains could broaden beyond semiconductors only if international oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields fall together.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index and is heavily weighted toward large technology and semiconductor companies. Oil prices and US Treasury yields influence global risk appetite and funding costs.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The article discusses the index recovering 7,000 and the outlook for sector breadth in the market.
